checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-help' completed successfully.
[1/4] UI readability: replace the field guide's 13 unlabeled color dots with labeled mixing equations, proven by a same-viewport screenshot pair and a scripted help-dialog run

impact_assessment.why: The field guide's mixing row renders 13 color discs with no text, labels, plus signs or equals signs; textContent is empty and the row is aria-hidden, so a first-time player gets no usable mixing reference from the help they just opened.
impact_assessment.benefits: The help dialog teaches red+green=yellow, green+blue=cyan, red+blue=magenta and all three=white in readable text, matching the in-game legend; the fix is static HTML/CSS with no runtime or dependency change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PLAYABLE.md static asset and relative URL rules; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no progress or save format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the markup inside index.html with existing color tokens, add a failing UI test before the change, extend dogfood to assert the visible equation labels, and run the canonical node --test plus aikit check iris.

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-01' completed successfully.

[1/4] Graphics and effects: animate the mirror line through a 180ms quarter turn in the click direction, proven by a paused mid-turn screenshot pair and a browser run that reads the animation and its final orientation

impact_assessment.why: Every mirror rotation rebuilds the board and swaps the line from +45deg to -45deg in one frame; the interaction has no motion, so the core verb of the game reads as a teleport rather than a turn.
impact_assessment.benefits: A short, direction-aware quarter-turn makes the central interaction legible and satisfying without changing the beam result, controls, timing or save format; reduced-motion users keep the instant swap.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PLAYABLE.md static assets only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no progress or level data change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Drive the animation from a transient state.spin keyed to the rotated cell, honour prefers-reduced-motion through the existing global rule, add a failing dogfood check before the CSS, and re-run the full campaign after the change.

checkpoints.description: [2/4]-[3/4] Corrected the inverted mirror glyph, added the direction-aware 180ms quarter-turn animation, and expanded dogfood to measure glyph angles, the animationstart event and the settled orientation

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-02' completed successfully.
[1/4] Audio cues: give hints their own cue and add a losing-charge cue, driven by a pure trace-difference helper, proven by new unit tests and a browser audio log during a played Crossroads run

impact_assessment.why: The hint currently reuses the dye cue and the unused error cue never plays. When a rotation uncharges a receiver the only feedback is visual, and the old count comparison cannot distinguish a receiver that charges from one that loses charge in the same move.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players hear a distinct hint ping and an audible loss when a route breaks; charge and uncharge are derived from the exact receiver set before and after the move rather than a net count, and the audio module finally has direct tests.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PLAYABLE.md still ships no audio files; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no progress or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep all cues generated in audio.js, add a one-function feedback module, record oscillator frequencies in the browser dogfood, and run the full campaign plus the existing hint, undo and sound-toggle checks.

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-03' completed successfully.

[1/4] Progression and saves: count title and chamber progress only for real campaign chambers, so a forged or stale save with ghost ids cannot inflate lit chambers or stars, proven by a forged-save screenshot pair and a reload run

impact_assessment.why: normalizeProgress keeps any non-empty level id, and solvedCount/starCount count every stored key. A save containing ghost ids shows lit chambers and stars for chambers that do not exist, while the chamber grid shows none, so the title and index disagree.
impact_assessment.benefits: The title, rank and chamber index summarize only the 12 authored chambers; older or hand-edited saves keep their real entries and ignore invented ones; the fix is a two-function signature change with no storage-format change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: progress keys stay under iris.progress.v1; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: read-only filtering, no record rewrite.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing progress tests for a ghost entry and a missing campaign list, pass LEVELS from the two app call sites, and verify the title and chambers screen from the same forged localStorage record before and after.

checkpoints.description: [2/4]-[3/4] Filtered solvedCount and starCount to authored campaign ids, required the level list at both call sites, added ghost-save failing-first tests, and captured forged-save before/after title and chamber pairs plus a ghost-save play run
